title: HSK 3 Practice: 选词填空, 判断对错, 阅读理解, 完成句子
description: HSK-3-style practice with this batch's grammar: word bank (把, 被, 才, 越来越), true/false, short reading, and building whole sentences.

points.title: 选词填空 (HSK 3)
points.summary: Each sentence shows four words from the same bank: 把, 被, 着, 才, 虽然, 越来越.
points.body:
- 把: doer + 把 + thing + verb + result.
- 被: thing + 被 + doer + verb + result.
- 才: later / fewer than expected.
- 越来越 + adj.

points.title: 判断对错 (HSK 3)
points.summary: Decide if the ★ statement matches the passage.
points.body: Watch out for 本来…可是 (planned, but), 虽然…但是 (the real opinion follows 但是), 一…就 (immediately after).
examples: I'd originally planned to go by train.

points.title: 阅读理解 (HSK 3)
points.summary: Read the passage and answer the ★ question.
points.body:
- 让 + person + verb = what someone wants another person to do.
- 虽然 … 还 … : progress, but not perfect yet.
examples: Mum told him to clean his room.

points.title: 完成句子: build the sentence
points.summary: HSK 3 writing part 1: put the words in order. Here: pick the piece in the ★ slot.
points.body:
- 把 / 被 + noun come before the verb.
- 着 follows the verb directly.
- 一 … 就 … frame the two events.

notes: 被 would make the window the doer.
才 = 'not until'.
着 follows a verb.
questions.translation: It's too hot — please open the window.

notes: 才 doesn't fit.
把 would make the phone break the brother.
着 follows a verb.
questions.translation: My phone was broken by my little brother.

questions.prompt: {他|tā}{昨天|zuótiān}{晚上|wǎnshang}{十二|shí'èr}{点|diǎn}（　）{回|huí}{家|jiā}，{妈妈|māma}{很|hěn}{生气|shēngqì}。
notes: 越来越 needs an adjective.
把 needs an object.
被 needs a doer.
questions.translation: He didn't get home until midnight last night — his mum was angry.

notes: 虽然 needs 但是.
才热了 — 才 doesn't take 了.
把 needs an object and a verb.
questions.translation: Summer's here — it's getting hotter and hotter.

questions.prompt:
{我|wǒ}{本来|běnlái}{想|xiǎng}{坐|zuò}{火车|huǒchē}{去|qù}{上海|Shànghǎi}，{可是|kěshì}{火车票|huǒchēpiào}{都|dōu}{卖|mài}{完|wán}{了|le}，{所以|suǒyǐ}{只好|zhǐhǎo}{坐|zuò}{飞机|fēijī}{去|qù}。

★ {他|tā}{是|shì}{坐|zuò}{火车|huǒchē}{去|qù}{的|de}。
notes: The train tickets were sold out — he flew.
questions.translation: I'd originally planned to take the train to Shanghai, but the tickets were sold out, so I had to fly. ★ He went by train.

questions.prompt:
{这|zhè}{家|jiā}{饭馆|fànguǎn}{的|de}{菜|cài}{虽然|suīrán}{有点儿|yǒudiǎnr}{贵|guì}，{但是|dànshì}{非常|fēicháng}{好吃|hǎochī}，{所以|suǒyǐ}{我|wǒ}{常常|chángcháng}{来|lái}。

★ {他|tā}{觉得|juéde}{这|zhè}{家|jiā}{饭馆|fànguǎn}{的|de}{菜|cài}{不|bù}{好吃|hǎochī}。
notes: 但是非常好吃 — he thinks it's delicious.
questions.translation: The food in this restaurant is a bit pricey, but it's delicious, so I come often. ★ He thinks the food here isn't good.

questions.prompt:
{我|wǒ}{一|yí}{下课|xiàkè}{就|jiù}{去|qù}{了|le}{图书馆|túshūguǎn}，{在|zài}{那儿|nàr}{看|kàn}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{个|ge}{小时|xiǎoshí}{书|shū}{才|cái}{回|huí}{家|jiā}。

★ {他|tā}{下课|xiàkè}{以后|yǐhòu}{去|qù}{了|le}{图书馆|túshūguǎn}。
notes: 一下课就去了图书馆 — right after class he went to the library.
questions.translation: As soon as class finished I went to the library, read there for two hours and only then went home. ★ He went to the library after class.

questions.prompt:
{小李|Xiǎo Lǐ}{的|de}{房间|fángjiān}{乱|luàn}{极了|jí le}：{床|chuáng}{上|shang}{放|fàng}{着|zhe}{衣服|yīfu}，{桌子|zhuōzi}{上|shang}{放|fàng}{着|zhe}{吃|chī}{完|wán}{的|de}{饭盒|fànhé}，{地|dì}{上|shang}{还|hái}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{书|shū}。{妈妈|māma}{让|ràng}{他|tā}{马上|mǎshàng}{把|bǎ}{房间|fángjiān}{打扫|dǎsǎo}{干净|gānjìng}。

★ {妈妈|māma}{希望|xīwàng}{小李|Xiǎo Lǐ}：
questions.explanation: 让 + him + **把房间打扫干净**.
notes: The books are on the floor — she wants them tidied, not read.
The lunch boxes are already eaten from.
The clothes are on the bed — but she asks for the whole room.
questions.translation: Xiao Li's room is a total mess: clothes on the bed, empty lunch boxes on the desk, and lots of books on the floor. His mum told him to clean the room at once. ★ What does his mum want?

questions.prompt:
{我|wǒ}{去年|qùnián}{来|lái}{北京|Běijīng}{的|de}{时候|shíhou}，{一|yí}{句|jù}{中文|Zhōngwén}{都|dōu}{不|bú}{会|huì}{说|shuō}。{现在|xiànzài}{我|wǒ}{能|néng}{跟|gēn}{中国|Zhōngguó}{朋友|péngyou}{聊天|liáotiān}{了|le}，{虽然|suīrán}{说|shuō}{得|de}{还|hái}{不|bú}{太|tài}{好|hǎo}。

★ {关于|guānyú}“{我|wǒ}”，{可以|kěyǐ}{知道|zhīdào}：
questions.explanation: Not a word → can chat now = **much better**.
notes: He chats with Chinese friends.
还不太好 — not very good yet.
一句都不会说 — not a word last year.
questions.translation: When I came to Beijing last year I couldn't say a single sentence of Chinese. Now I can chat with Chinese friends, though I still don't speak very well. ★ What do we know about the speaker?

questions.prompt:
{我|wǒ}　＿＿　　＿＿　　★　　＿＿　。
（{完了|wán le}・{做|zuò}・{作业|zuòyè}・{把|bǎ}）
questions.explanation: 我 **把 作业 做 完了**。
notes: 作业 is the object of 把 — slot 2.
把 comes first — slot 1.
完了 is the result — slot 4.

questions.prompt:
{我|wǒ}{的|de}{自行车|zìxíngchē}　＿＿　　＿＿　　★　　＿＿　。
（{走|zǒu}{了|le}・{小偷|xiǎotōu}・{被|bèi}・{偷|tōu}）
questions.explanation: 我的自行车 **被 小偷 偷 走了**。
notes: 被 comes first — slot 1.
The doer follows 被 — slot 2.
走了 is the result — slot 4.
questions.translation: My bike was stolen by a thief.

questions.explanation: 墙上 **挂 着 一张 地图**。
notes: 挂 is the verb — slot 1.
着 follows the verb — slot 2.
地图 ends the sentence — slot 4.
questions.translation: There's a map hanging on the wall.

questions.explanation: 他 **一 回家 就 睡觉**。
notes: 一 comes first — slot 1.
回家 is the first event — slot 2.
睡觉 is the second event — slot 4.
questions.translation: He goes to bed as soon as he gets home.
